findings.passage: This fight became deeply personal when gun violence shattered my world, leaving me to rebuild as a widowed single mother. That's when I learned that resilience isn't just about surviving, it's about transforming pain into purpose.
findings.note: Campaign-site statement signed Dr. Paula Swift. She says gun violence took her spouse and shaped her run. It names no policy, bill or type of gun law. Date is the site's last-updated stamp, not the date written.
